<SECTION-2 ACLASS="MANDATORY">
<TITLE ATOC="Y" AASSOCNOTE="D-0-1-6-0">6. 翡   </TITLE>
<P></P>
<P> ̻ȸ  ȸ Ǹ Ͽ  ǽ  , Ŀ  ̷   Ȯ   ȯ ְ Ͽ  ǽ Դϴ.&cr;</P>
<PGBRK></PGBRK>
<P>  (1) 翡  &cr;    1)    ֽ   ִ. ׷  ֽĿ   &cr;         ͹Ѿ 2 1 ϴ ݾ ʰ Ѵ.</P>
<P>    2) 1   ⸻  ָο   Ǵ ϵ &cr;         ڿ Ѵ.</P>
